title: Tavi
_note: PRO_01, PRO_02, PRO_04. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

bone.speaker: Tavi
bone.text: Da. I found a bone. Guess what it's from.

choices.spoken: A fish. A very old, very stubborn one.
Don't tell your mother, but it's a man's finger.

boneEnd.speaker: Tavi
boneEnd.text: It's going in the collection. Next to the beetle. The beetle is dead, Da, you don't need to look like that.

finger.speaker: Tavi
finger.text: [Delighted.] A finger! MAMA, IT'S A FINGER.

choices.text: [From the hearth, Nadira gives him a dry look.]

smoke.speaker: Tavi
smoke.text: Is Mr. Haddad's chimney always that smoky?

choices.spoken: Wash day. They burn a lot of wood on wash day.

gull.speaker: Tavi
gull.text: [Shy, proud, holding it out.] It's a gull. Its wing is crooked because I hit it.

choices.spoken: It's perfect. Crooked wings fly harder.

choices.text: [Dry] I'll keep it in my pocket.
choices.spoken: I'll keep it on me. Nobody touches it.

gullKept.speaker: Tavi
gullKept.text: Will you tell me the one about the gull who got lost? Properly. Not the way you did it last time.

gullBed.speaker: Tavi
gullBed.text: [Her face falls. She puts the gull on the shelf, wing first.] Fine.

day2.speaker: Tavi
day2.text: Is the boar big? Is it bigger than Dune? Bring me a tooth. A big one.
